verses.translation: Not long after this, Lysias the king's protector and cousin, who also managed the affairs, took sore displeasure for the things that were done.

translations.ron: Iar după puţină vreme Lisias, care era epitrop al regelui şi rudenie şi ispravnic peste toate treburile regelui foarte greu supărându-se pentru lucrul acesta ce s-a făcut,
translations.grk: Μετʼ ὀλίγον δὲ παντελῶς χρόνον Λυσίας ἐπίτροπος τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ συγγενὴς, καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν πραγμάτων, λίαν βαρέως φέρων ἐπὶ τοῖς γεγονόσι,

verses.translation: And when he had gathered about fourscore thousand with all the horsemen, he came against the Jews, thinking to make the city an habitation of the Gentiles,

translations.ron: A adunat aproape optzeci de mii şi toată călărimea, şi a venit împotriva Iudeilor, gândind să facă cetatea locaş Elinilor,
translations.grk: συναθροίσας περὶ τὰς ὀκτὼ μυριάδας καὶ τὴν ἵππον πᾶσαν, παρεγένετο ἐπὶ τοὺς Ἰουδαίους, λογιζόμενος τὴν μὲν πόλιν Ἕλλησιν οἰκητήριον ποιήσειν,

verses.translation: and to make a gain of the temple, as of the other chapels of the heathen, and to set the high priesthood to sale every year:

translations.ron: Templul să-l vândă cu bani, ca şi pe celelalte capişti ale păgânilor, şi arhieria în fiecare an să o scoată în vânzare.
translations.grk: τὸ δὲ ἱερὸν ἀργυρολόγητον καθὼς τὰ λοιπὰ τῶν ἐθνῶν τεμένη, πρατὴν δὲ τὴν ἀρχιερωσύνην κατʼ ἔτος ποιήσειν,

verses.translation: not at all considering the power of God, but puffed up with his ten thousands of footmen, and his thousands of horsemen, and his fourscore elephants.

translations.ron: Şi nicidecum nu se gândea la puterea lui Dumnezeu, ci se semeţea cu zecile de mii de pedestraşi şi cu miile de călăreţi şi cu optzeci de elefanţi.
translations.grk: οὐδαμῶς ἐπιλογιζόμενος τὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ κράτος, πεφρενωμένος δὲ ταῖς μυριάσι τῶν πεζῶν καὶ ταῖς χιλιάσι τῶν ἱππέων καὶ τοῖς ἐλέφασι τοῖς ὀγδοήκοντα.

verses.translation: So he came to Judea, and drew near to Bethsura, which was a strong town, but distant from Jerusalem about five furlongs, and he laid sore siege unto it.

translations.ron: Deci intrând în Iudeea, s-a îndreptat spre Betţur, care era în loc greu de ajuns şi departe de Ierusalim ca la cinci stadii, şi l-a împresurat.
translations.grk: Εἰσελθὼν δὲ εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν, καὶ συνεγγίσας τῷ Βαιθσούρᾳ, ὄντι μὲν ἐρυμνῷ χωρίῳ, ἀπὸ δὲ Ἱεροσολύμων ἀπέχοντι ὡσεὶ σταδίους πέντε, τοῦτο ἔθλιβεν.

verses.translation: Now when they that were with Maccabeus heard that he besieged the holds, they and all the people with lamentation and tears besought the Lord that he would send a good angel to deliver Israel.

translations.ron: Iar dacă au aflat cei care erau cu Iuda Macabeul că bate cetăţile, cu plângere şi cu lacrimi se rugau Domnului împreună eu tot poporul ca să trimită înger bun spre izbăvirea lui Israel.
translations.grk: Ὡς δὲ μετέλαβον οἱ περὶ τὸν Μακκαβαῖον πολιορκοῦντα αὐτὸν τὰ ὀχυρώματα, μετʼ ὀδύρμῶν καὶ δακρύων ἱκέτευον σὺν τοῖς ὄχλοις τὸν Κύριον, ἀγαθὸν ἄγγελον ἀποστεῖλαι πρὸς σωτηρίαν τῷ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.translation: Then Maccabeus himself first of all took weapons, exhorting the other that they would jeopard themselves together with him to help their brethren: so they went forth together with a willing mind.

translations.ron: Şi Macabeu, luând cel dintâi armele, a îndemnat pe ceilalţi să stea împreună cu el la primejdii şi să ajute pe fraţii săi.
translations.grk: Αὐτὸς δὲ πρῶτος ὁ Μακκαβαῖος ἀναλαβὼν τὰ ὅπλα προετρέψατο τοὺς ἄλλους, ἅμα αὐτῷ διακινδυνεύοντας, ἐπιβοηθεῖν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτῶν· ὁμοῦ δὲ καὶ προθύμως ἐξώρμησαν.

verses.translation: And as they were at Jerusalem, there appeared before them on horseback one in white clothing, shaking his armour of gold.

translations.ron: Şi împreună cu osârdie pornind, şi la Ierusalim fiind ei, s-a arătat un călăreţ eu haină albă mergând înaintea lor şi cu arme de aur sclipind.
translations.grk: Αὐτόθι δὲ καὶ πρὸς τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις ὄντων, ἐφάνη προηγούμενος αὐτῶν ἔφιππος ἐν λευκῇ ἐσθῆτι, πανοπλίαν χρυσῆν κραδαίνων.

verses.translation: Then they praised the merciful God all together, and took heart, insomuch that they were ready not only to fight with men, but with most cruel beasts, and to pierce through walls of iron.

translations.ron: Şi toţi împreună au binecuvântat pe milostivul Dumnezeu şi s-au întărit cu inimile, fiind gata a năvăli nu numai asupra oamenilor, ci şi asupra fiarelor sălbatice şi a zidurilor de fier.
translations.grk: Ὁμοῦ δὲ πάντες εὐλόγησαν τὸν ἐλεήμονα Θεὸν, καὶ ἐπεῤῥώσθησαν ταῖς ψυχαῖς, οὐ μόνον ἀνθρώπους ἀλλὰ καὶ θῆρας τοὺς ἀγριωτάτους, καὶ σιδηρᾶ τείχη τιτρώσκειν ὄντες ἕτοιμοι.

verses.translation: Thus they marched forward in their armour, having an helper from heaven: for the Lord was merciful unto them.

translations.ron: Deci, apropiindu-se cu bună rânduială, având ajutor pe Domnul cel din car, Care Se milostivea spre ei,
translations.grk: Προσῆγον ἐν διασκευῇ τὸν ἀπʼ οὐρανοῦ σύμμαχον ἔχοντες, ἐλεήσαντος αὐτοὺς τοῦ Κυρίου.

verses.translation: And giving a charge upon their enemies like lions, they slew eleven thousand footmen, and sixteen hundred horsemen, and put all the other to flight.

translations.ron: Şi ca nişte lei năvălind asupra vrăjmaşilor, au doborât la pământ din ei unsprezece mii de pedestraşi, precum şi o mie şase sute de călăreţi.
translations.grk: Λεοντηδὸν δὲ ἐντινάξαντες εἰς τοὺς πολεμίους, κατέστρωσαν αὐτῶν χιλίους πρὸς τοῖς μυρίοις, ἱππεῖς δὲ ἑξακοσίους πρὸς τοῖς χιλίοις· τοὺς δὲ πάντας ἠνάγκασαν φυγεῖν.

verses.translation: Many of them also being wounded escaped naked; and Lysias himself fled away shamefully, and so escaped.

translations.ron: Şi pe toţi i-au pus pe fugă şi mai mulţi dintre ei răniţi, goi au scăpat şi însuşi Lisias a scăpat fugind cu ocară.
translations.grk: Οἱ πλείονες δὲ αὐτῶν τραυματίαι γυμνοὶ διεσώθησαν· καὶ αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Λυσίας αἰσχρῶς φεύγων διεσώθη.

verses.translation: Who, as he was a man of understanding, casting with himself what loss he had had, and considering that the Hebrews could not be overcome, because the Almighty God helped them, he sent unto them,

translations.ron: Şi pentru că nu era lipsit de minte, chibzuind asupra înjosirii ce i s-a făcut şi socotind că Evreii sunt nebiruiţi, pentru că Atotputernicul Dumnezeu le ajută,
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἄνους δὲ ὑπάρχων, πρὸς ἑαυτὸν ἀντιβάλλων τὸ γεγονὸς περὶ ἐαυτὸν ἐλάσσωμα, καὶ συννοήσας ἀνικήτους εἶναι τοὺς Ἑβραίους, τοῦ πάντα δυναμένου Θεοῦ συμμαχοῦντος αὐτοῖς,

verses.translation: and persuaded them to agree to all reasonable conditions, and promised that he would persuade the king that he must needs be a friend unto them.

translations.ron: Trimiţând la ei, a făgăduit că toate cele drepte le va primi şi că şi pe rege îl va îndupleca să le fie prieten.
translations.grk: προσαποστείλας ἔπεισε συλλύσεσθαι ἐπὶ πᾶσι τοῖς δικαίοις· καὶ διότι καὶ τὸν βασιλέα πείσειν φίλον αὐτοῖς ἀναγκάζειν γενέσθαι.

verses.translation: Then Maccabeus consented to all that Lysias desired, being careful of the common good; and whatsoever Maccabeus wrote unto Lysias concerning the Jews, the king granted it.

translations.ron: Şi a ascultat Macabeu de rugăciunile lui Lisias, în toate purtând grijă de cele de folos; căci câte a cerut Macabeu lui Lisias prin scrisori în privinţa Iudeilor, regele le-a îngăduit.
translations.grk: Ἐπένευσε δὲ ὁ Μακκαβαῖος ἐπὶ πᾶσιν οἷς ὁ Λυσίας παρεκάλει τοῦ συμφέροντος φροντίζων· ὅσα γὰρ ὁ Μακκαβαῖος ἐπέδωκε τῷ Λυσίᾳ διὰ γραπτῶν περὶ τῶν Ἰουδαίων, συνεχώρησεν ὁ βασιλεύς.

verses.translation: For there were letters written unto the Jews from Lysias to this effect: Lysias unto the people of the Jews sendeth greeting:

translations.ron: Iar cărţile cele scrise de Lisias Iudeilor erau astfel: "Lisias, mulţimii Iudeilor, bucurie.
translations.grk: Ἦσαν γὰρ αἱ γεγραμμέναι τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ἐπιοτολαὶ παρὰ μὲν Λυσίου περιέχουσαι τὸν τρόπον τοῦτον· Λυσίας τῷ πλήθει τῶν Ἰουδαίων χαίρειν.

verses.translation: John and Absalon, who were sent from you, delivered me the petition subscribed, and made request for the performance of the contents thereof.

translations.ron: Ioan şi Abesalom, pe care voi i-aţi trimis, dând scrisorile cele de la voi, au cerut să împlinesc cele scrise în ele.
translations.grk: Ἰωάννης καὶ Ἀβεσσαλὼμ οἱ πεμφθέντες παρʼ ὑμῶν, ἐπιδόντες τὸν ὑπογεγραμμένον χρηματισμὸν, ἠξίουν περὶ τῶν διʼ αὐτοῦ σημαινομένων.

verses.translation: Therefore what things soever were meet to be reported to the king, I have declared them, and he hath granted as much as might be.

translations.ron: Deci câte se cădeau a se arăta regelui, am arătat, şi cele ce s-au întâmplat le-a iertat.
translations.grk: Ὅσα μὲν οὖν ἔδει καὶ τῷ βασιλεῖ προσενεχθῆναι διεσάφησα, ἃ δὲ ἦν ἐνδεχόμενα, συνεχώρησεν.

verses.translation: If then ye will keep yourselves loyal to the state, hereafter also will I endeavour to be a means of your good.

translations.ron: Deci de veţi păzi bunăvoinţa faţă de stăpânire, şi de aici înainte mă voi nevoi a mă face pricină de bunătăţi pentru voi.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν μὲν οὖν συντηρήσητε τὴν εἰς τὰ πράγματα εὔνοιαν, καὶ εἰς τὸ λοιπὸν πειράσομαι παραίτιος ὑμῖν ἀγαθῶν γενέσθαι.

verses.translation: But of the particulars I have given order both to these, and the other that came from me, to commune with you.

translations.ron: Şi pentru acestea am poruncit şi acestora şi celor de la mine trimişi, cu de-amănuntul să vă vorbească.
translations.grk: Ὑπὲρ δὲ τῶν κατὰ μέρος ἐντέταλμαι τούτοις τε καὶ τοῖς παρʼ ἐμοῦ διαλεχθῆναι ὑμῖν.

verses.translation: Fare ye well. The hundred and eight and fortieth year, the four and twentieth day of the month Dioscorinthius.

translations.ron: Fiţi sănătoşi. Anul o sută patruzeci şi opt, a lunii lui Distros, ziua a douăzeci şi patra".
translations.grk: Ἔῤῥωσθε· ἔτους ἑκατοστοῦ τεσσαρακοστοῦ ὀγδόου, Διοσκορινθίου εἰκοστῇ τετάρτῃ.

verses.translation: Now the king's letter contained these words: King Antiochus unto his brother Lysias sendeth greeting:

translations.ron: Iar epistola regelui cuprindea acestea: "Regele Antioh fratelui Lisias bucurie.
translations.grk: Ἡ δὲ τοῦ βασιλέως ἐπιστολὴ περιεῖχεν οὕτως· βασιλεὺς Ἀντίοχος τῷ ἀδελφῷ Λυσίᾳ χαίρειν.

verses.translation: since our father is translated unto the gods, our will is, that they that are in our realm live quietly, that every one may attend upon his own affairs.

translations.ron: După ce tatăl nostru s-a mutat între zei, noi vrem ca acei de sub cârmuirea noastră să fie netulburaţi întru a lor purtare de grijă;
translations.grk: Τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν εἰς θεοὺς μεταστάντος, βουλόμενοι τοὺς ἐκ τῆς βασιλείας ἀταράχους ὄντας γενέσθαι πρὸς τὴν τῶν ἰδίων ἐπιμέλειαν,

verses.translation: We understand also that the Jews would not consent to our father, for to be brought unto the customs of the Gentiles, but had rather keep their own manner of living: for the which cause they require of us, that we should suffer them to live after their own laws.

translations.ron: Auzind că Iudeii n-au voit a asculta de tatăl meu, ca să treacă la obiceiurile elineşti, ci mai bine voiesc să-şi ţină legea lor, iar acum se roagă de noi, ca să-i îngăduim să-şi ţină legea lor,
translations.grk: ἀκηκοότες τοὺς Ἰουδαίους μὴ συνευδοκοῦντας τῇ τοῦ πατρὸς ἐπὶ τὰ Ἑλληνικὰ μεταθέσει, ἀλλὰ τὴν ἑαυτῶν ἀγωγὴν αἱρετίζοντας, καὶ διὰ τοῦτο ἀξιοῦντας συγχωρηθῆναι αὐτοῖς τὰ νόμιμα αὐτῶν·

verses.translation: Wherefore our mind is, that this nation shall be in rest, and we have determined to restore them their temple, that they may live according to the customs of their forefathers.

translations.ron: Voind noi ca şi neamul acesta să fie fără tulburare, am judecat ca şi templul să li se întoarcă şi să petreacă după obiceiurile strămoşilor lor.
translations.grk: Αἱρούμενοι οὖν καὶ τοῦτο τὸ ἔθνος ἐκτὸς ταραχῆς εἶναι, κρίνομεν τό, τε ἱερὸν αὐτοῖς ἀποκατασταθῆναι, καὶ πολιτεύεσθαι κατὰ τὰ ἐπὶ τῶν προγόνων αὐτῶν ἔθη.

verses.translation: Thou shalt do well therefore to send unto them, and grant them peace, that when they are certified of our mind, they may be of good comfort, and ever go cheerfully about their own affairs.

translations.ron: Drept aceea bine vei face de vei trimite la ei şi vei încheia pace cu ei, ca ştiind voia noastră să fie cu inimă bună şi veseli să-şi isprăvească lucrurile lor".
translations.grk: Εὖ οὖν ποιήσεις διαπεμψάμενος πρὸς αὐτοὺς καὶ δοὺς δεξιὰς, ὅπως εἰδότες τὴν ἡμετέραν προαίρεσιν, εὔθυμοί τε ὦσι, καὶ ἡδέως διαγίνωνται πρὸς τὴν τῶν ἰδίων ἀντίληψιν.

verses.translation: And the letter of the king unto the nation of the Jews was after this manner: King Antiochus sendeth greeting unto the council, and the rest of the Jews;

translations.ron: Iar Epistola pe care a scris-o regele către neamul Iudeilor era astfel: "Regele Antioh, marelui sfat al Iudeilor şi celorlalţi Iudei bucurie.
translations.grk: Πρὸς δὲ τὸ ἔθνος ἡ τοῦ βασιλέως ἐπιστολὴ τοιαύτη ἦν· βασιλεὺς Ἀντίοχος τῇ γερουσίᾳ τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ τοῖς ἄλλοις Ἰουδαίοις χαίρειν.

verses.translation: If ye fare well, we have our desire; we are also in good health.

translations.ron: De sunteţi sănătoşi, sunteţi precum voim, şi noi suntem sănătoşi.
translations.grk: Εἰ ἔῤῥωσθε, εἴη ἂν ὡς βουλόμεθα· καὶ αὐτοὶ δὲ ὑγιαίνομεν.

verses.translation: Menelaus declared unto us, that your desire was to return home, and to follow your own business:

translations.ron: Arătatu-ne-a Menelau cum că voi voiţi a merge în patrie şi a fi la ale voastre.
translations.grk: Ἐνεφάνισεν ἡμῖν ὁ Μενέλαος βούλεσθαι κατελθόντας ὑμᾶς γίνεσθαι πρὸς τοῖς ἰδίοις.

verses.translation: wherefore they that will depart shall have safe conduct till the thirtieth day of Xanthicus with security.

translations.ron: Drept aceea, celor care se vor întoarce până în treizeci de zile ale lunii Xantic, le dăm liberă voie,
translations.grk: Τοῖς οὖν καταπορευομένοις μέχρι τριακάδος Ξανθικοῦ ὑπάρξει δεξιὰ μετὰ τῆς ἀδείας,

verses.translation: And the Jews shall use their own kind of meats and laws, as before: and none of them any manner of ways shall be molested for things ignorantly done.

translations.ron: Ca Iudeii să-şi ţină bucatele şi legile lor ca şi mai înainte, şi nimeni dintre ei nici o supărare să nu aibă pentru cele ce prin neştiinţă s-au făcut.
translations.grk: χρῆσθαι τοὺς Ἰουδαίους τοῖς ἑαυτῶν δαπανήμασι καὶ νόμοις καθὰ καὶ τὸ πρότερον, καὶ οὐδεὶς αὐτῶν κατʼ οὐδένα τρόπον παρενοχληθήσεται περὶ τῶν ἠγνοημένων.

verses.translation: I have sent also Menelaus, that he may comfort you.

translations.ron: Şi am trimis şi pe Menelau să vă mângâie.
translations.grk: Πέπομφα δὲ καὶ τὸν Μενέλαον παρακαλέσοντα ὑμᾶς.

verses.translation: Fare ye well. In the hundred forty and eighth year, and the fifteenth day of the month Xanthicus.

translations.ron: Fiţi sănătoşi. Anul o sută patruzeci şi opt, în cincisprezece zile ale lunii Xantic".
translations.grk: Ἔῤῥωσθε· ἔτους ἑκατοστοῦ τεσσαρακοστοῦ ὀγδόου, Ξανθικοῦ πέμπτῃ καὶ δεκάτῃ.

verses.translation: The Romans also sent unto them a letter containing these words: Quintus Memmius and Titus Manlius, ambassadors of the Romans, send greeting unto the people of the Jews.

translations.ron: Trimis-au şi Romanii la ei carte aşa scrisă: "Quintus Memius, şi Titus Manlius, împuterniciţii Romanilor, poporului Iudeilor, bucurie!
translations.grk: Ἔπεμψαν δὲ καὶ οἱ Ῥωμαιοῖ πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἐπιστολὴν ἔχουσαν οὕτως· Κόϊντος Μέμμιος, Τίτος Μάνλιος, πρεσβύται Ῥωμαίων, τῷ δήμῳ τῶν Ἰουδαίων χαίρειν.

verses.translation: Whatsoever Lysias the king's cousin hath granted, therewith we also are well pleased.

translations.ron: Cele ce Lisias, ruda regelui, v-a îngăduit, şi noi le îngăduim.
translations.grk: Ὑπὲρ ὧν Λυσίας ὁ συγγενὴς τοῦ βασιλέως συνεχώρησεν ὑμῖν, καὶ ἡμεῖς συνευδοκοῦμεν.

verses.translation: But touching such things as he judged to be referred to the king, after ye have advised thereof, send one forthwith, that we may declare as it is convenient for you: for we are now going to Antioch.

translations.ron: Iar pentru cele ce a judecat să se supună împăratului, trimiteţi pe cineva îndată, după ce veţi fi cercetat toată pricina, ca să înfăţişăm totul împăratului precum voiţi voi, fiindcă noi venim la Antiohia.
translations.grk: Ἃ δὲ ἔκρινε προσανενεχθῆναι τῷ βασιλεῖ, πέμψατέ τινα παραχρῆμα ἐπισκεψάμενοι περὶ τούτων, ἵνα ἐκθῶμεν ὡς καθήκει ὑμῖν· ἡμεῖς γὰρ προσάγομεν πρὸς Ἀντιόχειαν.

verses.translation: Therefore send some with speed, that we may know what is your mind.

translations.ron: Drept aceea, grăbiţi şi trimiteţi pe careva, ca şi noi să ştim ce voiţi.
translations.grk: Διὸ σπεύσατε, καὶ πέμψατέ τινας, ὅπως καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐπιγνῶμεν ὁποίας ἐστὲ γνώμης.

verses.translation: Farewell. This hundred and eight and fortieth year, the fifteenth day of the month Xanthicus.

translations.ron: Fiţi sănătoşi. Anul o sută patruzeci şi opt, zile cincisprezece ale lunii Xantic".
translations.grk: Ὑγιαίνετε· ἔτους ἑκατοστοῦ τεσσαρακοστοῦ ὀγδόου, Ξανθικοῦ πέμπτῃ καὶ δεκάτῃ.
